frequencyResponse.notes: Mackie specification text on this distributor page (part 2042231-00, model Thump15, listed as discontinued): 'Frequency Response (–3 dB) 39 Hz – 20 kHz'. The '(–10 dB) 32 Hz – 23 kHz' figure is a different measure and is not stored as the response.

power.notes: Rated power on the same page: 'System Power Amplification Rated Power 500W rms' (LF 400 W rms Class D; HF 100 W rms Class AB). This is amplifier output, not a speaker power-handling rating; the basis is rated RMS.
